dataset.anomalyClass: 500 synthetic labelled pollution profiles (chemical spill / turbidity event / oxygen depletion / acidification)
dataset.normalClass: 2000 rows sampled from ml/ocean_sensor_data.csv (extreme 0.5% tail excluded)

disclaimer: SYNTHETIC VALIDATION ONLY. The Isolation Forest is unsupervised (no ground-truth labels at train time). These numbers measure separation of the training distribution from extreme synthetic pollution profiles. They do NOT measure real-world deployment performance and must not be presented as production accuracy.
